## Testing
- [ ] The automatic **Checks** on this pull request are green
- [ ] I checked the affected page(s) locally, or in the Vercel preview
- [ ] Not needed for this change

> Editing from the GitHub website? You do not need to run anything locally —
> just wait for the Checks to go green before merging. A red X means do not
> merge; the live site is unaffected until you do. See section 9 of
> `docs/project-handover.md`.

## Content and translation checks
- [ ] Text is clear and reviewed
- [ ] English (`en.ts`) and Norwegian (`no.ts`) are both updated where needed
- [ ] Malayalam (`ml.ts`) updated, or left to fall back to English on purpose
- [ ] Message text contains no Markdown (`**bold**` shows literal asterisks)
- [ ] Links, email addresses, and social URLs were checked
- [ ] New photos were compressed before upload (target under 500 KB each)
- [ ] New event `date` values are `YYYY-MM-DD` in quotes

## Deployment notes
- [ ] This is safe to deploy to production
- [ ] Follow-up work is needed after merge
